About Me

Hello! I'm Skylar, a freelance illustrator with a passion for bringing stories and ideas to life through visual art. With over 8 years of experience in digital and traditional illustration, I specialize in character design, fantasy landscapes, and whimsical concepts.

My work combines vibrant colors, detailed line work, and imaginative storytelling. Whether you're looking for concept art, book illustrations, or personalized commissions, I'm here to collaborate and create something extraordinary together.

When I'm not illustrating, you can find me exploring nature, reading fantasy novels, or experimenting with new artistic techniques.

Commission Services

I love working with clients to bring their visions to life. Whether you need character art, book illustrations, or custom designs, I'm ready to create something special for you.

Character Design

Fully developed character concepts with multiple poses and expressions. Perfect for games, books, or personal projects.

Starting at $150

pages.html:

Custom Illustration Commissions

I create bespoke illustrations tailored to your vision. Whether you need character art, editorial illustrations, or concept designs, I'm here to bring your ideas to life.

Commission Rates & Packages

All prices are starting points and can be customized based on complexity, revisions, and timeline. Rush fees may apply for expedited work.

Character Design

$250 – $500

  • Full-body character illustration
  • 2 rounds of revisions
  • Digital file (high-res PNG)
  • 5–7 business days

Portrait Commission

$150 – $300

  • Head-and-shoulders or bust portrait
  • 2 rounds of revisions
  • Digital file (high-res PNG)
  • 3–5 business days

Concept/Scene Art

$400 – $800

  • Complex scene with multiple elements
  • 3 rounds of revisions
  • Digital file (high-res PNG + layered PSD)
  • 10–14 business days

How the Commission Process Works

  1. 1. Inquiry & Consultation

    You fill out the commission form with details about your project: subject, style, size, and deadline. I'll respond within 24 hours to discuss your vision and provide a detailed quote.

  2. 2. Agreement & Deposit

    Once we've agreed on the scope and price, I'll send you an invoice. A 50% deposit is required to secure your spot on my schedule; the remainder is due upon completion.

  3. 3. Sketches & Feedback

    I'll create initial sketches based on your brief and share them with you. This is your chance to request changes and adjustments before I move to the final illustration.

  4. 4. Final Illustration

    I'll bring your approved sketch to life with color, shading, and all the finishing details. You'll receive a high-resolution digital file ready for print or web use.

  5. 5. Delivery & Support

    Your final artwork is delivered, and I'm happy to make minor tweaks if needed. You own the rights to your commissioned piece and can use it however you wish.

What Clients Say

"Skylar captured the personality of my DnD character perfectly. The turnaround was quick, and she was so patient with my revision requests. I couldn't be happier!"

— Jamie M., Tabletop Gamer

"I commissioned a character design for my indie game, and the quality exceeded my expectations. Skylar's art brought depth and charm to my vision. Highly recommended!"

— Alex R., Game Developer

"Working with Skylar was a dream. She understood my creative direction from day one and delivered a stunning portrait that I use for all my author platforms."

— Dr. Elena K., Author

"The level of detail and professionalism is outstanding. Not only is the artwork beautiful, but the communication throughout the process made it stress-free."

— Marcus T., Business Owner

Request a Commission

Ready to commission your custom illustration? Fill out the form below with as much detail as you can, and I'll get back to you within 24 hours.
